name: IDisplay
statusMeaning: Tried in the game with Kiln.
author: Enabify
description: Just a simple mod: hold V key while hovering over an item in your inventory to see more details

softOff.why: only events, HUD, keys, commands and guarded mixin handlers

works: Hold V while hovering an item to add its id and component changes to its tooltip. Hovering a diamond sword with damage 40 while V is held (pressed before the inventory opened): the tooltip adds 'minecraft:diamond_sword' and '[minecraft:damage=40]'; without V it has neither.
